init.title: Calendar subscription
init.description:
Subscribe to these links in any calendar app (Apple, Google, Outlook, Thunderbird). Anyone with a link can see the due dates and titles, so share it only with people you trust.

**All accounts:**
`{all_url}`

**Only {account}:**
`{account_url}`

The calendar app must be able to reach this address. Google Calendar fetches it from Google's servers, so Home Assistant must be reachable from the internet; if it sits behind a login proxy (e.g. Authelia), allow `/api/stadtbibliothek/ics/` without login.

data.regenerate_token: Create new links (the old ones stop working)
